capabilities: Sign exported PDFs with PKCS#7/X.509 certificates (.pfx/.p12)
Stamp custom footers and page numbers on every PDF page
Generate self-signed certificates from the settings
Check PDF signature integrity and detect appended bytes
Choose Integrity signature or Certify (DocMDP P=1) signing modes
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed in the manifest; supports beta install via BRAT and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. Certificate passwords are stored in Obsidian's SecretStorage, not data.json. Limits: 64 MiB per PDF and 4 MiB per PKCS#12 file. No trusted timestamps, PAdES T/LT/LTA, TSA services, or trust-chain/revocation validation; already-signed PDFs are rejected. Bundles pdf-lib, node-forge, and @signpdf; all signing runs locally with no network calls.
problem: Obsidian's PDF export cannot produce cryptographically signed documents or stamp signer names and page numbers on every page without external tools like OpenSSL or Python.

relations.evidence: For optional independent validation and trust configuration, see pyHanko's guide.

summary: PDF post-processing plugin that cryptographically signs exported PDFs with X.509/PKCS#7 certificates and stamps custom running footers and page numbers.
